title: Getting here
body: County Square is two minutes' walk from Paisley Gilmour Street station. Blue badge parking is available on Gilmour Street.

title: Opening weekend line-up announced
body: Local choirs open the market on Saturday 28 November at 12 noon, followed by the lights switch-on at 5pm.

title: Trader applications are open
body: Apply online for a chalet, gazebo or food van pitch. We aim to reply to every application within ten working days.
